title: Pod Salt Nexus Blueberry Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pod Salt Nexus Blueberry Lemonade Nic Salt offers a bright and refreshing fruit fusion. Juicy Blueberries bring a rich, deep, jammy sweetness, that really comes alive when layered against the citrus tang of sparkling Lemonade, creating a fresh and well-defined vape. The result is a perfectly balanced combination that captures both the rich, tart sweetness of berries and the bubbly zestiness of Lemonade. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with vape starter kits , pod vape kits , refillable vapes , and vape pens . The nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid absorption with a tactile yet comfortable throat hit, making it an excellent choice for vapers who prefer satisfying flavour with discreet vapour. Pod Salt is an award-winning UK e-liquid brand recognised for premium Nic Salt formulations. The Nexus collection showcases inventive fruit and beverage-inspired blends crafted to deliver authentic taste and consistent performance.
